svg.text: A122 - S33 (= S34 = K19) certified against A108's S07 and Trump. All three sit on the SAME six-cell k6_07 slot skeleton (BL column of three, BL(1,0), BR(0,0), TR(0,0)); they are three distinct local minima of the side.

S07 is the 45° point (every tilt equal, side in Q(√2)); S33 has FOUR different tilts (0°, 40.00° twice, 51.45°, 47.09°) and its f0 is UPRIGHT, flush against the column's right face x = 1; Trump lifts BL(0,2) off the column. Green circles = contact points.
s* − s0 = +0.008534; same k6_07 skeleton, every tilt 45°
s-hat − s0 = −0.00000041; the global minimum, five squares at 40.182°, column lifted
contacts: f0–f1, f0–f3, f0–BL(0,1), f0–BL(0,2), f1–f2
walls: f2–top, f4–right, BL(0,0)–left, BL(0,0)–bottom, BL(0,1)–left
contacts: f0–f1, f0–f2, f0–f4, f0–BL(0,1), f1–f2
walls: f1–top, BL(0,0)–left, BL(0,0)–bottom, BL(0,1)–left, BL(0,2)–left
contacts: f0–f2, f0–f4, f0–u6, f0–u7, f1–f2
walls: f1–top, f3–right, f5–left, f5–bottom, u6–left
